subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw split the public hosted scripts/install.sh into sourced modules, keep a self-contained installer artifact, or generate one hosted script from internal modules?
rationale: The request is a maintainability improvement on a stable public setup artifact, and automation should not choose the installer packaging strategy for maintainers.

options.title: Keep one hosted script
options.body: Keep scripts/install.sh self-contained and allow only targeted internal cleanup that preserves the current served curl|bash artifact.

options.title: Generate one script from modules
options.body: Approve module source files only if a checked generator emits the same single hosted installer artifact with equivalent smoke proof.

options.title: Serve multiple installer files
options.body: Move to a multi-file installer layout and update website sync, docs, and install proof around fetching every required helper safely.

recommendation.title: Keep one hosted script
recommendation.body: Keep scripts/install.sh self-contained and allow only targeted internal cleanup that preserves the current served curl|bash artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: The public artifact and website-sync decision most directly intersects the installer sync and validation workflow history.
